newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Erwin says South African economy performing well.
newsitem.headline: Erwin says South African economy performing well.

text.p: South African Trade and Industry Minister Alec Erwin said on Thursday that the South African economy was performing strongly and the outlook for jobs was brightening.

"The real economy is performing well. All the structural features we are hoping to strengthen with GEAR (the Growth, Employment and Redistribution strategy) are moving in the right direction," he told reporters at a briefing.
Erwin said private investment was buoyant and exports good.
"Capacity utilisation is rising. We now envisage that new investment will be job-creating -- the employment front now looks a lot better."
Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals on Tuesday estimated South African unemployment at 23 to 25 percent of the economically active population.
